page.overview:
What is Little Gerais?

The Little Gerais is a ship used by the Little Pirates.

The Little Gerais is a massive, wide-set ship with a brown hull, a gold-colored bow, white railing, and a figurehead that resembles the crew's jolly roger, except with the horns pointed down. It has a single, tall mast with three large sails on it, two bearing the crew's jolly roger and a striped one in the middle with two sun emblems on it. The mast is topped with a crow's nest and a flag bearing the jolly roger.

The ship was among the fleet of Whitebeard's allies when they went to war at Marineford. The status of the ship is unknown, as its captain was last seen unconscious on the battlefield.
